cards.question: What must reconcile before closing an MCI?
cards.answer: Patient counts: triage tags = transport log = hospital arrivals (+ dead and released on scene).

cards.question: Why demobilize in phases?
cards.answer: Late-found patients, re-triage needs, rehab, and possible re-escalation.

cards.question: Demobilization checklist per unit?
cards.answer: Crew accounted for and checked, equipment decontaminated, restocked, returned to service, release logged.

cards.question: What is a hot wash?
cards.answer: Short, informal debrief immediately after the incident: what worked, what didn't, immediate safety issues.

cards.question: Four AAR questions?
cards.answer: What was supposed to happen? What happened? Why the difference? What to sustain/improve?

cards.question: Exercise types to test MCI plans?
Rehab trigger example (NFPA 1584)?
cards.answer: After two 30-minute SCBA cylinders or ~40 minutes of intense work.

cards.question: What is Psychological First Aid?
cards.answer: Evidence-informed support: ensure safety/needs, listen without forcing details, link to support — 'Look, Listen, Link'.

cards.question: Is mandatory single-session debriefing recommended?
cards.answer: No — it doesn't prevent PTSD and may cause harm; use PFA and voluntary peer support.

cards.question: When to refer a responder for mental-health care?
cards.answer: Symptoms persisting beyond ~1 month, worsening function, substance misuse, or any suicidal thoughts (immediately).

cards.question: Key MCI documents?
cards.answer: Triage tags, transport log, unit assignments/times, TQ times, antidotes/decon, exposure logs, ePCRs.
